description: Fetch full content from a MeteoSwiss webpage and convert to markdown or plain text. Use the search tool first to discover valid page URLs, then pass the full URL as the id parameter.

format.description: The output format for the content

id.description: Identifier of a MeteoSwiss page to fetch. For this server the id is a full URL returned by the search tool. Example: https://www.meteoschweiz.admin.ch/klima/klimawandel/steigende-temperaturen.html

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata in the response

name: fetch

id.description: The id the content was fetched for (the page URL)

metadata.description: Page metadata (present when includeMetadata is true)

text.description: Canonical body field (matches ChatGPT Deep Research spec)

url.description: Canonical URL field (matches ChatGPT Deep Research spec). For this server `url === id`.
